name: A Night Out
source:
Elle, a young closeted trans woman, sneaks out of her parents house to see her favorite band perform. What happens that night is not what she expected. 

[From [url=https://froey.itch.io/a-night-out]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
艾丽是一位年轻的未出柜的跨性别女性，她偷偷溜出父母的家去看她最喜欢的乐队的表演。那天晚上发生的事情却出乎她的意料。

[来自[url=https://froey.itch.io/a-night-out]itch.io[/url]]
